mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = 'LOCKED', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_at = #{now}, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status IN ('INIT', 'FAILED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until <= #{now})

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = 'DONE', consumed_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = 'LOCKED'

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = 'LOCKED' AND retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count

UPDATE mq_outbox SET consume_status = 'DEAD', dead_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND consume_status = 'LOCKED'
